Pack: load 24.script: (function(){/*storage_pack_load:v1:[[],[[117,2]]]*/const D={"L_p117":"[[690,{\"name\":\"Secret Note: Gigantomachia\",\"conditions\":[{\"type\":\"read-boolean\",\"key\":\"nf117\",\"operator\":\"equals\",\"value\":true},{\"type\":\"read-number\",\"key\":\"currentDay\",\"operator\":\"greaterThanOrEqual\",\"value\":1}],\"effects\":[{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"Gigantomachia's master is All For One (narrator only): the villain who steals Quirks and gives them to others, the man Tomura Shigaraki calls Sensei. Gigantomachia has been his bodyguard for many years and is devoted to him heart and soul. All For One gave him several Quirks on top of his own Endurance; unlike a Nomu, his body holds them without remodeling and he keeps his own mind, which makes him one of All For One's most valued and closely kept servants. Most of what he can do beyond Endurance comes from those Quirks; canon does not list them all.\"},{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"He is too conspicuous to keep close, so he waits in the mountains, far from towns, as All For One ordered, and sleeps there between orders. All For One's doctor, Daruma Ujiko, who lives as Kyudai Garaki, belongs to the same small circle and knows where he waits. All For One means Tomura Shigaraki to command him one day; Gigantomachia takes no order from Tomura, or anyone else, until Tomura has endured him in a fight and proven himself in his eyes. That test waits for the story.\"},{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"The ravines where he sleeps lie below the Gunga Mountain villa, and the Meta Liberation Army's members drill on those slopes. Canon gives him no contact with the army before the League's own arc: he has no tie to them, they do not know he is there, and he ignores them unless they block his path, until the story brings them together.\"},{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"Play him in the record's terms: he says only \\\"Master\\\", never a name, and nothing he says reveals who his master is. At the start of the year he knows nothing of the League's plans and cares about none of them.\"},{\"type\":\"write-boolean\",\"key\":\"nf117\",\"operator\":\"set\",\"value\":false}],\"recurring\":true}],[691,{\"name\":\"Secret Note: All Might (Retired)\",\"conditions\":[{\"type\":\"read-boolean\",\"key\":\"nf118\",\"operator\":\"equals\",\"value\":true},{\"type\":\"read-number\",\"key\":\"currentDay\",\"operator\":\"greaterThanOrEqual\",\"value\":1}],\"effects\":[{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"All Might's real name, never made public, is Toshinori Yagi. He was born Quirkless. His power is One For All, a Quirk that stockpiles strength and passes from holder to holder, each adding to it; he is its eighth holder. He received it as a young man from his master, Nana Shimura, the seventh holder, whom All For One, the villain who steals Quirks and gives them to others, killed while Toshinori was still in training. Her old partner Gran Torino (Sorahiko Torino) trained him at U.A. with brutal sparring, and the memory still makes All Might shake.\"},{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"About six years ago, five years before he met Izuku Midoriya, All For One gave him a wound in a battle All Might believes he won: it tore open his left side, destroyed half his respiratory system and cost him his stomach, and it never healed. Since then he can hold his muscular hero form only a limited time each day: about three hours when he met Izuku, less now after overexertion, and hard fights shorten it further. When it runs out he deflates in a burst of steam into his true form, a tall, gaunt man with hollow cheeks, sunken eyes and drooping blond tufts, lost in clothes cut for his hero form, who coughs up blood; in that form he is gentle, tired and self-deprecating. Hero work on the way in spends the day's time, so he arrives late, and every clumsy excuse covers a change. Recovery Girl treats him behind her closed door; her Quirk cannot heal the old wound.\"},{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"Only a few know his condition and One For All: Principal Nezu, Recovery Girl, Gran Torino, Naomasa Tsukauchi, Sir Nighteye and Izuku Midoriya. The rest of the faculty, Shota Aizawa included, know only that he keeps irregular hours and must sometimes rest after hero work, and they cover for him without asking why. Students and public know nothing until the story reveals it. Sir Nighteye, his longtime sidekick, used Foresight on him after the injury and saw him die violently fighting a villain, years ahead; he begged All Might to retire, was refused, and they have not spoken since, unless the story brings them together.\"},{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"Ten months before the entrance exam, Izuku Midoriya, then Quirkless, ran at the sludge villain to save Katsuki Bakugo while pros held back, and All Might chose him to inherit One For All. He had Izuku clear Dagobah Municipal Beach Park of junk for ten months, then passed him the Quirk on the morning of the exam in a strand of hair to eat. At the start of the year every full release still breaks the limb it passes through; publicly Izuku has a strength Quirk that appeared late. All Might teaches at U.A. above all to raise him, tries not to favor him openly, and fails. What remains in All Might are embers of the power, fading with each use.\"},{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"All Might believes he killed All For One but has never been sure, and tells Izuku about him only when the story has him do it. At the start of the year he knows nothing of the League of Villains or Tomura Shigaraki, nor, unless the story reveals it, that Tomura is Nana Shimura's grandson.\"},{\"type\":\"write-boolean\",\"key\":\"nf118\",\"operator\":\"set\",\"value\":false}],\"recurring\":true}]]"};let changed=false;for(const k of Object.keys(D)){if(storage[k]!==D[k]){storage[k]=D[k];changed=true;}}if(!changed)delete triggers["Pack: load 24"];})();
